comment:
* Contains a list of string constants used to get or set telephone properties
 * in the system. You can use {@link android.os.SystemProperties os.SystemProperties}
 * to get and set these values.
 * @hide

variables.name: PROPERTY_BASEBAND_VERSION
variables.comment:
* Baseband version
     * Availability: property is available any time radio is on

variables.name: PROPERTY_RIL_IMPL
variables.comment: Radio Interface Layer (RIL) library implementation.

variables.name: PROPERTY_OPERATOR_ALPHA
variables.comment:
Alpha name of current registered operator.

* Availability: when registered to a network. Result may be unreliable on * CDMA networks.

variables.name: PROPERTY_OPERATOR_NUMERIC
variables.comment:
Numeric name (MCC+MNC) of current registered operator.

* Availability: when registered to a network. Result may be unreliable on * CDMA networks.

variables.name: PROPERTY_OPERATOR_ISMANUAL
variables.comment:
'true' if the device is on a manually selected network
     *
     *  Availability: when registered to a network

variables.name: PROPERTY_OPERATOR_ISROAMING
variables.comment:
'true' if the device is considered roaming on this network for GSM
     *  purposes.
     *  Availability: when registered to a network

variables.name: PROPERTY_OPERATOR_ISO_COUNTRY
variables.comment:
The ISO country code equivalent of the current registered operator's * MCC (Mobile Country Code)

* Availability: when registered to a network. Result may be unreliable on * CDMA networks.

variables.name: PROPERTY_LTE_ON_CDMA_PRODUCT_TYPE
PROPERTY_LTE_ON_CDMA_DEVICE
variables.comment:
* The contents of this property is the one of {@link Phone#LTE_ON_CDMA_TRUE} or
     * {@link Phone#LTE_ON_CDMA_FALSE}. If absent the value will assumed to be false
     * and the {@see #PROPERTY_LTE_ON_CDMA_PRODUCT_TYPE} will be used to determine its
     * final value which could also be {@link Phone#LTE_ON_CDMA_FALSE}.
     * {@see BaseCommands#getLteOnCdmaMode()}

variables.name: PROPERTY_SIM_STATE
variables.comment: * One of "UNKNOWN" "ABSENT" "PIN_REQUIRED" * "PUK_REQUIRED" "NETWORK_LOCKED" or "READY"

variables.name: PROPERTY_ICC_OPERATOR_NUMERIC
variables.comment:
The MCC+MNC (mobile country code+mobile network code) of the
     *  provider of the SIM. 5 or 6 decimal digits.
     *  Availability: SIM state must be "READY"

variables.name: PROPERTY_ICC_OPERATOR_ALPHA
variables.comment:
PROPERTY_ICC_OPERATOR_ALPHA is also known as the SPN, or Service Provider Name.
     *  Availability: SIM state must be "READY"

variables.name: PROPERTY_ICC_OPERATOR_ISO_COUNTRY
variables.comment: ISO country code equivalent for the SIM provider's country code

variables.name: PROPERTY_DATA_NETWORK_TYPE
variables.comment: * Indicates the available radio technology. Values include: "unknown", * "GPRS", "EDGE" and "UMTS".

variables.name: PROPERTY_INECM_MODE
variables.comment: Indicate if phone is in emergency callback mode

variables.name: PROPERTY_ECM_EXIT_TIMER
variables.comment: Indicate the timer value for exiting emergency callback mode

variables.name: PROPERTY_OPERATOR_IDP_STRING
variables.comment: the international dialing prefix of current operator network

variables.name: PROPERTY_OTASP_NUM_SCHEMA
variables.comment: * Defines the schema for the carrier specified OTASP number

variables.name: PROPERTY_DISABLE_CALL
variables.comment: * Disable all calls including Emergency call when it set to true.

variables.name: PROPERTY_RIL_SENDS_MULTIPLE_CALL_RING
variables.comment: * Set to true for vendor RIL's that send multiple UNSOL_CALL_RING notifications.

variables.name: PROPERTY_CALL_RING_DELAY
variables.comment: * The number of milliseconds between CALL_RING notifications.

variables.name: PROPERTY_CDMA_MSG_ID
variables.comment:
* Track CDMA SMS message id numbers to ensure they increment
     * monotonically, regardless of reboots.

variables.name: PROPERTY_WAKE_LOCK_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: * Property to override DEFAULT_WAKE_LOCK_TIMEOUT

variables.name: PROPERTY_RESET_ON_RADIO_TECH_CHANGE
variables.comment:
* Set to true to indicate that the modem needs to be reset
     * when there is a radio technology change.

variables.name: PROPERTY_SMS_RECEIVE
variables.comment:
* Set to false to disable SMS receiving, default is
     * the value of config_sms_capable

variables.name: PROPERTY_SMS_SEND
variables.comment:
* Set to false to disable SMS sending, default is
     * the value of config_sms_capable

variables.name: PROPERTY_TEST_CSIM
variables.comment:
* Set to true to indicate a test CSIM card is used in the device.
     * This property is for testing purpose only. This should not be defined
     * in commercial configuration.

variables.name: PROPERTY_IGNORE_NITZ
variables.comment: * Ignore RIL_UNSOL_NITZ_TIME_RECEIVED completely, used for debugging/testing.

variables.name: PROPERTY_MULTI_SIM_CONFIG
variables.comment:
* Property to set multi sim feature.
     * Type:  String(dsds, dsda)

variables.name: PROPERTY_REBOOT_REQUIRED_ON_MODEM_CHANGE
variables.comment:
* Property to indicate if reboot is required when changing modems configurations
     * Type:  String(true, false) default is false; most devices don't need reboot

variables.name: PROPERTY_DEFAULT_SUBSCRIPTION
variables.comment: * Property to store default subscription.

variables.name: PROPERTY_MMS_TRANSACTION
variables.comment:
* Property to enable MMS Mode.
     * Type: string ( default = silent, enable to = prompt )

variables.name: PROPERTY_SIM_COUNT
variables.comment: * Set to the sim count.

variables.name: PROPERTY_VIDEOCALL_AUDIO_OUTPUT
variables.comment:
* Controls audio route for video calls.
     * 0 - Use the default audio routing strategy.
     * 1 - Disable the speaker. Route the audio to Headset or Bluetooth
     *     or Earpiece, based on the default audio routing strategy.

variables.name: DISPLAY_OPPORTUNISTIC_SUBSCRIPTION_CARRIER_TEXT_PROPERTY_NAME
variables.comment:
'true' if the carrier text from opportunistic subscription should be used to display
     * on UI.
     *

variables.name: PROPERTY_MAX_ACTIVE_MODEMS
variables.comment:
* How many logical modems can be active simultaneously. For example, if a device is dual-SIM
     * capable but currently only one SIM slot and one logical modem is active, this value is still
     * two.
     * Type: int
